tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas behind the sidebar and workspace (zinc-950 / zinc-50).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, panels, table body (zinc-900 / white).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, hovered rows, active nav item, code chips (zinc-800 / zinc-100).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Agent console and log wells; sits inside a surface.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (zinc-800 / zinc-200). Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control outlines; 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, table metadata on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, word counts on surface and surface-sunken only (≥4.5:1 there).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Indigo-600 fill: primary buttons, active tab underline, selected node ring. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of an accent fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Indigo text, links, icons, focus ring and active nav icon on bg, surface, surface-raised, accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Indigo tint behind accent-text: active nav item, selected chunk, accent badges.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Emerald fill: Approve & Dispatch, live status dots, completed agent nodes. Text on it is on-success.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on success.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Emerald text: ‘Active’, ‘AUDIT PASS’, high intent scores, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken, success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Emerald tint behind success-text in badges and the verification report.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Amber text: pending checkpoint, medium intent, on surface, surface-sunken, warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Amber tint behind warning-text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rose fill for destructive confirmations. Text on it is on-accent (white).

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Rose text: ‘AUDIT FAIL’, errors, Reject outline, on surface, surface-sunken, danger-soft. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Rose tint behind danger-text.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Sky text for tool calls (call_tool) in the console, on surface-sunken and surface.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series (indigo). Validated with chart-2 for colour-blind separation in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second data series (teal). Never reuse status colours for series.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per view: the workspace page title.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles, table headers, node names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A physicist trapped in a single repeating second.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary lines, helper text, nav links.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels and sidebar section headings.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Console logs, tool names, server ids, chunk ids.

styles.name: mono-tag
styles.usage: Metadata tags, word counts, intent scores.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, row gaps in lists.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Workspace padding and gaps between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between page header and content.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Metadata tags, console chips, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, agent nodes, drawers.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and pill badges.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus and the review drawer only; cards use borders, not shadows.
